description: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data categories within the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, with six distinct segments corresponding to the categories listed in the legend: Moroccan Names (orange), Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy) (purple), Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives) (brown-orange), Translated Sentences (yellow), Extra + Augmented Data (blue-grey), and Pending Translations (light green). Each segment is labeled with its absolute count, and the chart includes a legend to associate each color with its respective category. The largest segment is Translated Sentences, with a value of 45,387, followed by Pending Translations at 43,000, Extra + Augmented Data at 30,000, and the remaining three categories (Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories, Syntactic Roles) are significantly smaller, with their exact values obscured by gray bars or being visually minimal. The chart is presented with a white hole in the center and appears to be sorted in descending order by value, with the largest segments positioned at the top and bottom of the chart.
